cases.title: 每次 Manual Run 生成新 UUID 代表新意图；同 Execution ID/Key 重复投递/上传按幂等验证

covered_dimensions: manual run #1 -> 2 fresh execution UUIDs; identical manual run #2 -> 2 more fresh UUIDs disjoint from run #1 (4 distinct UUIDs across 2 runs, 2 per node)

an identical POST /api/tasks/{id}/run body is deliberately NOT deduplicated: each manual run is a new intent, so the hub mints new Execution IDs (this is the 'new intent' half of the case, verified with real requests)
Executions list UI shows 4 rows for the task (2 per run) with distinct IDs - no row merging
remaining_or_limitations: the 'same Execution ID/Key repeated delivery/upload is idempotent' half was NOT exercised at runtime: no UI or HTTP path re-delivers one Execution ID (the hub always creates a fresh UUID for a manual run and there is no client-supplied idempotency key), and injecting a duplicate protocol frame (RUN_EXECUTION / EXECUTION_FINISHED) is outside this batch's authorization

read-only corroboration only (not counted as runtime evidence): internal/agent/agent.go OnRunExecution returns early when the local journal already holds the Execution ID; internal/hub/execution.go MarkFinished returns nil for an already-terminal record and UpsertFromAgent ('Agent 重连后上报执行结果（幂等）') never regresses a terminal record; scheduled runs dedupe on the task+node+slot key (errSlotExists)
closing this dimension needs either Root authorization for a duplicate-frame injector/protocol harness, or explicit acceptance of the code-level corroboration

observations.detail: UPLOADING and DELIVERING have no zh/en label in StatusBadge, so the transfers table shows the raw enum while PENDING/SUCCESS/CANCELED/FAILED are localized (re-confirmation of batch03 OBS-B03-01; web/src/features/shared/ui.tsx).
for a deleted application the sub-resource still answers 200 with a null body instead of 404, while GET /api/applications/{id} correctly answers 404 (no existence guard on the sub-resource).
models.Execution.ExitCode is tagged exit_code,omitempty, so a successful run (exit 0) omits the field and the UI shows '-' instead of '0'.

FileTransferManager.Cancel takes m.mu, which handleUpload holds for the whole upload body, so a cancel issued while UPLOADING is applied only after the staged upload finishes (observed: cancel POST at t+385 ms, CANCELED at t+2.734 s after 300 MiB was staged). Intent is honored (nothing delivered, staged blob removed) but the cancel can appear to lag on large files and the hub accepts the full upload first.
deleting the owned task left its 4 execution records queryable (GET /api/executions?task_id=... still returns them) - history is preserved as expected; task_name resolves to null in the UI.

harness_notes: radix dropdown menus do not open on a synthetic element.click(); the row-menu automation had to dispatch a pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click sequence. Recorded because a naive click silently leaves the menu closed (first P22-12a attempt).

the accessibility refs renumber after every radix menu open/close, so a fill issued against a ref captured before a Select interaction silently lands on the wrong element; the form driver re-snapshots before every interaction (runners/form_transfer.py).
agent-browser 'network requests --json' includes the Authorization: Bearer header; all saved network evidence was redacted (header dropped, Bearer tokens replaced) before writing to evidence/.
a background poller (20 ms cadence) was used to record the server-side status timeline; it writes to a file and is parsed afterwards because piping the CLI output races with the pipeline stages.
no agent-browser or harness failure changed any case conclusion.
